name: Urinary Tract Infection
overview: Urinary Tract Infection is a health condition that requires individualized medical assessment. Symptoms, causes, and treatment vary by person — consult a qualified doctor in India for diagnosis and a care plan tailored to your history and local guidelines.
symptoms: From a clinical perspective, lower UTIs affect the bladder (cystitis) or urethra while upper UTIs affect the kidney (pyelonephritis).
From a clinical perspective, symptoms from a lower UTI include burning or pain during urination, pain in the lower abdomen and the urge to urinate even when the bladder is empty.
In routine practice, symptoms of a kidney infection are more systemic and include fever or flank pain, usually in addition to the symptoms of a lower UTI.
In routine practice, rarely, the urine may appear bloody.
